page.layout: One title page, all lines centred and printed upside down. Engraved device (printer's mark) in the middle, below the title lines. Imprint at the foot.
page.notes: The whole page is printed upside down, so reading order runs from the bottom of the scan up. The title lines are faint and partly worn; most words are illegible or doubtful. The engraving shows a globe or emblem with figures on both sides; no text is printed in it. The imprint line "A AMSTERDAM" is fairly clear; the printer's name and the date at the foot are not readable with confidence. Show-through from the reverse is faint and was not transcribed. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible.
